description: Deletes a Sitecore item over the Authoring and Management API. By default the item goes to the recycle bin and can be restored; permanently true destroys it outright. Deleting an item deletes its descendants with it. Supply exactly one of id or path.

database.description: The database holding the item. Defaults to master.

id.description: The item's GUID. Supply this or path.

path.description: The item's full path. Supply this or id.

permanently.description: When true, delete outright instead of moving to the recycle bin. Not reversible.

name: authoring-delete-item
